in_marathi.name: Chinmaya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Consciousness of the Absolute
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinmaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Chinmaya is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Chin’ which means consciousness and ‘maya’ which means the Absolute. It signifies the consciousness of the Absolute. The name is associated with the ancient Hindu scripture Bhagavad Gita.
